name: mini-ai
description: Mini AI: a Virtual Key Account Manager for marketplace sellers (demo).

scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w @mini-ai/server && npm run build -w @mini-ai/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mini-ai/server && npm run typecheck -w @mini-ai/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @mini-ai/server && npm run lint -w @mini-ai/client
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.demo:reset: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('server/runtime',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Action Tracker and seller memory cleared.')"
scripts.deploy:vercel: npm run build && node scripts/build-vercel.mjs && vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod
